Jubilee.reason: Jubilee Line: Minor delays following a late finish of engineering work at Stratford and Wembley Park.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Wembley Park and Baker Street northbound only due to an earlier faulty train at Neasden. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Piccadilly.reason: PICCADILLY LINE: Wednesday 28, Thursday 29 and Friday 30 October, no service between Cockfosters and Uxbridge. Trains continue to operate between Acton Town and Heathrow, all terminals. Use the METROPOLITAN LINE between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge, and ELIZABETH LINE services between Central London and Heathrow. Replacement bus services operate.

Suffragette.reason: Suffragette Line: No service between South Tottenham and Barking Riverside due to a operational incident. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line. London Underground and London Buses are accepting tickets via any reasonable routes. Disruption is expected until the end of the week.

Tram.reason: LONDON TRAMS: Saturday 24 October to Thursday 5 November, no service between East Croydon and Beckenham Junction / Elmers End / New Addington due to planned engineering work. SOUTHERN services continue to serve Birkbeck, except on Sundays. Replacement bus services operate
